name: Infinite Power cuts the owned Timerend rank's cooldown (#10702)
contract: Infinite Power 92118 reads 'Casting damaging spells now reduces your damaging spell cooldowns by $528312s1% of their remaining cooldown.' Its proc 503946 names Timerend rank 1 801291 in effect 0 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN_PCT, base points 9 = 10%). Timerend ranks 1-7 are 801291, 501831-501835 and 572578 (Spell.dbc Rank 1..Rank 7, SpellLevel 4/14/22/30/38/46/52), all in Category 887 with CategoryRecoveryTime 20000. A level-60 Chronomancer casts rank 7 572578, whose cooldown the client shows and Spell::CheckCast enforces. A control Chronomancer without Infinite Power casts the same rank right after the talented one, so its cooldown is at least as long; the talented caster's cooldown can only fall below the control's through the proc. The talented caster then casts Wand of Time 520175, a direct damage spell: 10% of a remaining cooldown of 15 s or more is at least 1.5 s.
